relationships.subject: dry eye disease
relationships.evidence_quote: in situ hybridization showed DED to trigger upregulation of TRPV1, TRPA1, ASIC1, and ASIC3 mRNA in the ophthalmic branch of the TG

relationships.subject: dry eye disease
relationships.evidence_quote: sodium channel 1.8 (Nav1.8) and 1.7 (Nav1.7) mRNA levels were 166% and 293% higher in DED than sham animals, respectively

relationships.subject: capsazepine
relationships.evidence_quote: Capsazepine treatment resulted in Nav1.8 and Nav1.7 mRNA levels that were 40% and 62% lower, respectively, than in animals treated with vehicle

relationships.subject: dry eye disease
relationships.evidence_quote: The mRNA levels of prostaglandin-endoperoxide synthase 2 (PTGS2), also known as cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2), prostaglandin E synthase 3 (PTGES3), and prostaglandin E receptor 3 (PTGER3), were 502%, 500%, and 342% higher, respectively, in the TG of DED than sham animals

relationships.subject: capsazepine
relationships.evidence_quote: Repeated instillations of capsazepine reduced corneal polymodal responsiveness to heat, cold, and acidic stimulation in ex vivo eye preparations.

key_findings: Severe dry eye upregulates TRPV1, TRPA1, ASIC1/3, Nav1.7/1.8, COX-2 and cytokine genes in trigeminal ganglion.
Topical capsazepine reduced corneal nerve hyperactivity, pain-gene upregulation, ocular pain and anxiety-like behavior.
